notes.title: The Making of AYAHUASCA KOSMIK JOURNEY
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Zuwf38cUSXI

We are excited to share with all Aya fans (and future Aya fans) the insider story of what went into the making of AYAHUASCA Kosmik Journey.

French Director Jan Kounen shares his insights about Ayahuasca and why VR was the right medium to capture the mysterious and powerful effects of the Ayahuasca plant. 

"it's a medicine of natural science. It's in nature that you find plants and it's using these plants from nature that you enter a space that looks like virtual reality... a different world that you can interact with nature itself."
- Jan Kounen
